title: Writing / Brand Narrative / Messages by audience
slide_intent: Adapt emphasis to audience motivation so a shared promise answers different people’s reasons for engaging.
strategic_value: Audience-specific versions of the same invitation can help Duolingo connect learning, institutional adoption, employment and community participation.
demonstration: Five labeled rows pair audience groups with headlines and paragraphs, ranging from consumers to institutions, prospective employees and contributors.
practical_value: Choose the relevant motivation while keeping the same voice; treat audience labels and numerical claims as historical.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that diverse audiences need messages matched to their motivations.
